specification_status: SPECIFIED_BEFORE_PARSER_IMPLEMENTATION (Constitution Article VIII: the ruleset and the calibration corpus ground truths were authored before the parser was written and run; disagreements found later are parser defects, never corpus/rules edits)
principles: DETERMINISM: parse(span, context) is a pure function of its inputs; no LLM, no locale, no clock, no randomness.
LOSSLESSNESS: every normalized value retains the exact raw source span; the raw span is never normalized, trimmed, or canonicalized in place.

NEVER_MANUFACTURE_PRECISION: approximations (~50) stay approximate points with the approximator retained as a flag — they are never widened into ranges; inequalities keep their open bound open; significant digits are never extended; unit conversions are never performed by the parser (conversion is a separate, explicitly-recorded operation if ever needed).
EXACT_DECIMAL_ARITHMETIC: uncertainty-to-range uses decimal.Decimal (0.42 ± 0.03 -> [0.39, 0.45] exactly, never 0.39000000000000001).
FAIL_CLOSED: unparseable numeric-looking spans are MALFORMED with an explicit reason, never coerced, never laundered into NOT_NUMERIC (a serialization defect is distinct from missing evidence).
CONTEXT_TYPING: VALUE and YEAR are separate parse contexts supplied explicitly by the caller; the parser never guesses.

value_context_rule_cascade.semantics: whole-span case-insensitive match to the frozen qualitative vocabulary; canonical term recorded; raw span retained

no digits and no numeric marker -> NOT_NUMERIC; a numeric marker without a value (inequality symbol/word, approximator, bare ±) -> MALFORMED_NO_BOUND_VALUE / MALFORMED_NO_VALUE / MALFORMED_NO_CENTER_VALUE (serialization defect, not missing evidence)
two adjacent range separators (e.g. 0.1--10) are malformed, never silently collapsed
lossless: the stated ± bound IS the interval; [center-unc, center+unc] by exact decimal arithmetic
at least/no less than/greater than/over/above -> lower bound; at most/no more than/less than/under/below -> upper bound; bound stays open
lower/upper bound by symbol direction; open_bound records the canonical symbol; the opposite bound is NEVER set
POINT at the stated number with approximation_marker=true; NO range is manufactured; the approximator is preserved in the raw span
a dangling connector is never mistaken for a unit
both-endpoint units must agree; inverted endpoints (20 to 10) -> MALFORMED_INVERTED_RANGE, never silently swapped
trailing non-numeric token is the unit (verbatim + canonical alias); trailing numeric junk -> MALFORMED_NOT_A_NUMBER
anything else that contains digits but matches no rule

year_context_rule_cascade.semantics: no 4-digit number and no digits -> NOT_NUMERIC; digits but no 4-digit year -> MALFORMED_NOT_A_YEAR

explicit_non_goals: No unit conversion: the parser never converts units; conversion is a separately-recorded operation so the raw span remains the single truth.
No fuzzy span matching at the binding stage: byte-exact occurrence counting only.
No thousands separators (1,000): the comma is a list separator in the TVM serialization contract; accepting it would create list/value ambiguity.
No leading-dot decimals (.5 must be written 0.5): keeps the grammar unambiguous.
No LLM anywhere in parsing, normalization, or verification.
